```{r}
# Calculate methylation profiles manually 
library(GenomicRanges)

calculate_meth_profile <- function(meth_data, promoters, nbins = 41) {
  # Create bins for each promoter
  bin_width <- width(promoters) / nbins
  
  profiles <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(promoters), ncol = nbins)
  
  for(i in 1:length(promoters)) {
    prom <- promoters[i]
    
    # Create bins within this promoter
    bin_starts <- start(prom) + (0:(nbins-1)) * bin_width[i]
    bin_ends <- bin_starts + bin_width[i] - 1
    
    bins <- GRanges(seqnames = seqnames(prom),
                   ranges = IRanges(start = bin_starts, end = bin_ends),
                   strand = strand(prom))
    
    # Find overlaps and calculate mean methylation per bin
    for(j in 1:nbins) {
      overlaps <- findOverlaps(bins[j], meth_data)
      if(length(overlaps) > 0) {
        meth_values <- meth_data$score[subjectHits(overlaps)]
        profiles[i, j] <- mean(meth_values, na.rm = TRUE)
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(profiles)
}

# Calculate profiles manually
hap1_profile <- calculate_meth_profile(f_hap1_mc_reg, windows, 41)
hap2_profile <- calculate_meth_profile(f_hap2_mc_reg, windows, 41)

# Calculate means per bin
av_hap1_manual <- apply(hap1_profile, 2, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
av_hap2_manual <- apply(hap2_profile, 2, mean, na.rm = TRUE)

summary(av_hap1_manual)  # Should be 0-1
summary(av_hap2_manual)  # Should be 0-1

av_df<-as.data.frame(av_hap1_manual)
colnames(av_df)<-c("pro")
av_df$bin<-c(1:41)
av_df$bin<-as.factor(av_df$bin)

av_melt<-melt(av_df, id.vars="bin", measure.vars=c("pro"), variable.name = "pattern")

setwd("/Users/ksenia/Documents/Lab_Garvan/projects/marsupials/X_chr/Xchr_pro/")
pdf("F_hap1_hap1_Xchr_promoters_5kb_manual.pdf", useDingbats=FALSE, width=10, height=10) 
print(ggplot(av_melt, aes(x=bin, y=value, fill=pattern, group=pattern)) +
    geom_line() + 
  geom_point(shape=21, size=1.5, alpha=0.8) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("red")) +
    ylim(0,1) +
  ylab("Average methylation") +
  xlab("Bin #") +
  theme_bw()) #PrEC.av.meth.per.bin
dev.off()



av_df<-as.data.frame(av_hap2_manual)
colnames(av_df)<-c("pro")
av_df$bin<-c(1:41)
```
